stem: The Dravidian races are mainly confined at which of the following parts of India?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The Dravidian race is mainly concentrated in southern India. It is associated with the Dravidian language family. Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Telugu and Tulu are major Dravidian languages. Dravidian people are also found in parts of central and south-eastern India.

stem: Which amongst the following states has no identified tribal community?
expl: According to the 2011 Census, tribal communities have not been identified in Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi and Puducherry.
The Gaddi tribe resides in Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, and Ladakh.
The Bodo tribe is an ethnic and multilingual community mainly found in Assam and also in the Garo Hills region.

The Garo tribe is mainly associated with the state of Meghalaya, According to the 2023-24 report released by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, the Law Tribe found in Meghalaya as well as in the State of Assam, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura and West Bengal. Therefore the most appropriate option is (d).
The Bhil tribe inhabits the Indian states of Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh (including Telangana), Karnataka, Tripura, and Rajasthan.

stem: Which of the following pairs of tribe and state is not correct?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: As per the given options— (a) Bhil - Gujarat, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Tripura, etc. (b) Gaddi - Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh (c) Kota - Tamil Nadu, Karnataka (d) Toda - Tamil Nadu, Karnataka Therefore, the Toda tribe is not from Kerala.

stem: In which province is the Bharmaur tribal region located?
expl: The Bharmaur tribal area is located in Himachal Pradesh. The headquarters of the Integrated Tribal Development Project, Bharmaur, is in Shimla.
